note: What each component announces: the ARIA roles it puts on the page and the element its own title renders as, resolved through the component it opens with — ConfirmDialog is a Modal, so it carries Modal's title element. Read by `dsbridge migrate --semantics`, which diffs this against an app's components before a swap: the difference between a `dialog` and an `alertdialog`, or a title that is a heading and one that is not, is invisible to a type-check and turns up as a red test suite afterwards. A component that announces one role under a condition and another otherwise lists both — which of the two is on the page is a prop's decision, and a migration is read before either renders. Two entries here are not in the source: Modal takes its dialog role as a prop, and Sheet gets its own from the internal Overlay it wraps. semantics.published.test.ts holds every other value to the components.
